examples.text: vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

66202.meaning2: big tree which bears fruit without flowers
66202.commentary: (MNa) osadhitiṇavanappatīsū'ti harītakīāmalakī'ādīsu osadhīsu tālanāḷiker'ādīsu tiṇesu vanajeṭṭhakesu ca vanappatirukkhesu adhivatthā devatā. (ANa) vanappatī'ti vanajeṭṭhakā.
66202.sanskrit: vanaspati, śākhin, vṛkṣa, pādapa, mahīruha, kuja, aga, taru, druma

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi
vanappati nāma yo manussānaṃ pariggahito hoti rukkho paribhogo. theyyacitto chindati, pahāre pahāre āpatti dukkaṭassa.

66203.meaning1: forest; woodland plain; (comm) uncultivated land outside the village
66203.commentary: (MNa) vanapatthan'ti atikkamitvā manussānaṃ upacāraṭṭhānaṃ, yattha na kasanti na vapanti. (MNa) vanesu patthaṃ gahanaṭṭhāne sen'āsanaṃ vanapatthaṃ.

examples.text: catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu n'ālaṃ araññavanappatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevituṃ. katamehi catūhi? kāmavitakkena, byāpādavitakkena, vihiṃsāvitakkena, duppañño hoti jaḷo elamūgo
araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ

66205.meaning1: middle of the wood; centre of the forest
66205.commentary: (DNa) vehāyasā te vanamajjhappattā'ti te ākāsen'eva imaṃ mahāvanaṃ sampattā.

examples.text: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanamajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.
kiṃ nu tvaṃ mataputtā'va, ekam'āsi rudammukhī, vanamajjhagatā ekā, purisaṃ nu gavesasī'ti.

66206.meaning1: gone to the middle of the wood; entered amidst the forest

examples.text: kiṃ nu tvaṃ mataputtā'va, ekam'āsi rudammukhī, vanamajjhagatā ekā, purisaṃ nu gavesasī'ti.

66207.meaning1: reached the middle of the wood
66207.commentary: (DNa) vehāyasā te vanamajjhappattā'ti te ākāsen'eva imaṃ mahāvanaṃ sampattā.

examples.text: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanam'ajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.
yo nibbanatho van'ādhimutto, vanamutto vanam'eva dhāvati, taṃ puggalam'etha passatha, mutto bandhanam'eva dhāvati.

66209.meaning1: eating roots and fruits of the forest

examples.text: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

te tattha sākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, sāmākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, nīvārabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, daddulabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, haṭabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, kaṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, ācāmabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, piññākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, tiṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, gomayabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, vanamūlaphal'āhārā yāpesuṃ pavattaphalabhojī.

66210.meaning1: entering the forest; plunging into the wood

examples.text: sojja bhaddo anutrāsī, pahīnabhayabheravo, jhāyati vanam'ogayha, putto godhāya bhaddiyo.
kānanaṃ vanam'ogayha, vasāmi vipine ahaṃ, vipassiṃ addasaṃ buddhaṃ, āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ.

66211.meaning1: delightfulness of a wood; loveliness of a grove

examples.text: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha, tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi rājagahassa ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti.
abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti

66212.commentary: (SNa) vanaropā'ti sayaṃjāte aropimavane sīmaṃ parikkhipitvā cetiya-bodhi-caṅkamana-maṇḍapa-kuṭi-leṇa-rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭṭhānānaṃ kārakā chāy'ūpage rukkhe ropetvā dadamānā'pi vanaropāy'eva nāma.

examples.text: ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.

66213.meaningLit: discourse on the planter of forests

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe
tatth'addasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, pāsādikañ'ca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñ'ca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
tam'anugacchanto addasaṃ purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddhāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ. taṃ, bhante, nagaraṃ māpehī'ti.

66217.meaning2: big tree which bears fruit without flowers
66217.sanskrit: vanaspati, śākhin, vṛkṣa, pādapa, mahīruha, kuja, aga, taru, druma

66221.meaning1: resorted to the forest; living in the wood

examples.text: na yattha gītaṃ na'pi yattha vāditaṃ, eko araññe van'avassito muni, accherarūpaṃ paṭibhāti maṃ idaṃ, yadekako pītimano vane vase.

66223.meaning1: inclined to the forest; inclined to the monk's life

examples.text: yo nibbanatho van'ādhimutto, vanamutto vanam'eva dhāvati, taṃ puggalam'etha passatha, mutto bandhanam'eva dhāvati.

66224.meaning1: who lives in the forest; living in the wood

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā sīhassa migarañño nadato saddaṃ suṇanti, yebhuyyena bhayaṃ saṃvegaṃ santāsaṃ āpajjanti, bilaṃ bil'āsayā pavisanti, dakaṃ dak'āsayā pavisanti, vanaṃ van'āsayā pavisanti, ākāsaṃ pakkhino bhajanti.

66227.commentary: (SNa) vanibbakā'ti ye, iṭṭhaṃ, dinnaṃ, kantaṃ, manāpaṃ, kālena, anavajjaṃ dinnaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyya, gacchatu bhavaṃ brahmalokan'ti-ādinā nayena dānassa vaṇṇaṃ thomayamānā vicaranti.

examples.text: yo brāhmaṇaṃ samaṇaṃ vā, aññaṃ vā'pi vanibbakaṃ, musāvādena vañceti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānaṃ.

66228.commentary: (SNa) vanibbakā'ti ye iṭṭhaṃ, dinnaṃ, kantaṃ, manāpaṃ, kālena, anavajjaṃ dinnaṃ, dadaṃ cittaṃ pasādeyya, gacchatu bhavaṃ brahmalokan'tiādinā nayena dānassa vaṇṇaṃ thomayamānā vicaranti. yācakā'ti ye pasatamattaṃ detha, sarāvamattaṃ dethā'ti-ādīni ca vatvā yācamānā vicaranti.

examples.text: bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, sirī nāma rājā ahosiṃ dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī. tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇaddhika-vanibbakayācakānaṃ. atha kho maṃ, bhante, itthāgāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati.

66229.meaning1: living in the forest; of the wood
66229.commentary: (ANa) revato khadiravaniyo'ti dhammasenāpatittherassa kaniṭṭhabhātiko. so yathā aññe therā araññe vasamānā vanasabhāgaṃ udakasabhāgaṃ bhikkhācārasabhāgañ'ca sallakkhetvā araññe vasan'ti, na evaṃ vasi. etāni pana sabhāgāni anādiyitvā ujjaṅgalasakkharapāsāṇavisame khadiravane paṭivasati. tasmā āraññakānaṃ aggo'ti vutto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āraññakānaṃ yadidaṃ revato khadiravaniyo.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ vante puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti?
evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojane se vante.
taṇhā avijjā ca piy'āpiyañ'ca, subhāni rūpāni sukhā ca vedanā, manāpiyā kāmaguṇā ca vantā, vante ahaṃ āvamituṃ na ussahe.
yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.

66232.meaning2: who has left behind all fault
66232.commentary: (DHPa) vantakasāvassā'ti catūhi maggehi vantakasāvo chaḍḍitakasāvo pahīnakasāvo assa. (JAa) yo ca vantakasāvassā'ti yo pana puggalo yathāvuttasseva kasāvassa vantattā vantakasāvo assa.

examples.text: yo ca vantakasāvassa, sīlesu susamāhito, upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.

66233.meaning1: free from ill-will; without aversion; purged of hatred

examples.text: yassa c'etaṃ samucchinnaṃ, mūlaghaccaṃ samūhataṃ, sa vantadoso medhāvī, sādhurūpo'ti vuccati.

66234.meaning1: free from faults; without wrong; purged of defect

examples.text: yassa c'etaṃ samucchinnaṃ, mūlaghaccaṃ samūhataṃ, sa vantadoso medhāvī, sādhurūpo'ti vuccati.
yamhi saccañ'ca dhammo ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo, sa ve vantamalo dhīro, thero iti pavuccati.

66236.meaning1: free from worldliness; disgorged the bait of the world

examples.text: akathaṃkathissa tusitassa, vantalok'āmisassa muditassa, katasamaṇassa manujassa, antimasārīrassa narassa, anopamassa virajassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

66237.meaning1: vomited one's food; given up hope

examples.text: assaddho akataññū ca, sandhicchedo ca yo naro, hat'āvakāso vant'āso, sa ve uttamaporiso.

66238.meaning1: free from desire; given up all wants
66238.commentary: (DHPa) catūhi maggehi kattabbakiccassa katattā, sabbā āsā iminā vantā'ti vant'āso.

examples.text: assaddho akataññū ca, sandhicchedo ca yo naro, hat'āvakāso vant'āso, sa ve uttamaporiso.

66239.meaning1: who has given up; who has renounced; who has cast off

66240.meaning2: heap of what is thrown up by ants

66241.grammar: pp, nt nom sg of vanta
66241.commentary: (MNa) se vante'ti taṃ vantaṃ. aṭṭhasamāpattilābhino hi heṭṭhāsamāpattiyo vantasadisā hutvā upaṭṭhahanti, puna samāpajjissāmī'ti cittaṃ na uppajjati. ten'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: aduñ'hi, bhante, bhattaṃ paṭikūlasammatan'ti. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojane se vante.

66242.commentary: (JAa) vandako'ti buddh'ādīnaṃ kalyāṇamittānaṃ vandako hutvā punabbhave paṭivandanaṃ labhati.

examples.text: tassā te svāgataṃ bhadde, tato te adurāgataṃ, evañ'hi dantā āyanti, satthu pādāni vandikā, vītarāgā visaṃyuttā, katakiccā anāsavā.
pūjako labhate pūjaṃ, vandako paṭivandanaṃ, yaso kittiñ'ca pappoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.

66243.commentary: (SNPa) vandati satthuno'ti evaṃ bhaṇanto gopphakesu pariggahetvā pañcapatiṭṭhitaṃ vandi.

examples.text: samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā, vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, samaṇ'īdha jātihīnaṃ, abhivādenti khattiyā'ti.
taṃ tathāvādiniṃ buddho, mamaṃ so etadabravi, na h'evaṃ vandiyā buddhā, yathā vandasi gotamī.

66244.commentary: (THIa) vandanaṃ dāni me vajjāsī'ti mama vandanaṃ vadeyyāsi, mama vacanena lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ vadeyyāsī'ti attho.

examples.text: āraddhavīriye pahit'atte, niccaṃ daḷhaparakkame, samagge sāvake passa, etaṃ buddhāna'vandanaṃ.
vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ, padakkhiṇañ'ca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ.

66246.meaning1: for the sake of worship; for the sake of adoration

examples.text: āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.
āmisahetū'ti cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu sen'āsanahetu gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhāra-hetu sakkārahetu garukārahetu mānanahetu vandanahetu pūjanahetu.

66248.meaning1: made of reverence; composed of devotion
66248.meaning2: made of devotion; composed of reverence
66248.commentary: (DNt) vandīyate vandanā, sā'va vandanāmayaṃ yathā dānamayaṃ sīlamayan'ti. vandanā c'ettha kāya-vācā-cittehi tiṇṇaṃ ratanānaṃ guṇaninnatā, thomanā vā. apica tassā cetanāya sahajātādopakāreko saddhāpaññāsativīriy'ādi-sampayuttadhammo vandanā, tāya pakatan'ti vandanāmayaṃ yathā sovaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamayan'ti, atthato pana yathāvuttacetanā'va.

examples.text: iti me pasannamatino, ratanattayavandanāmayaṃ puññaṃ, yaṃ suvihatantarāyo, hutvā tass'ānubhāvena.
yadi'pi taṃ vandanāmayaṃ puññaṃ pavattikkhaṇavasena parittaṃ, khettamahantatāya pana phalamahantatāya ca ativiya mahantam'evā'ti āha pahūtakatakalyāṇā'ti.
candaṃ yathā khay'ātītaṃ, pecca pañjalikā janā, vandamānā namassanti, lokasmiṃ gotamaṃ.

66252.synonym: anavamata, apacita, garukata, pūjita, vandita, sakkata, sammata

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpeyyaṃ, itthan'nāmo, bhante, mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī'ti.

66256.meaning1: having made pay respect (to someone at the feet)
66256.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā ti ye tattha sannipatitā bhikkhū, tesaṃ pāde vandāpetvā (VMVt) pāde vandāpetvā'ti pād'ābhimukhaṃ namāpetvā. dūre vandanto'pi hi pāde vandatī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā, ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā, bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā, añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā, evaṃ vadehī'ti vattabbo
atha kho āyasmā ānando kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi, itthan'nāmo, bhante, mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī'ti.
tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.
raññā pana vandite bhagavantaṃ avanditvā ṭhātuṃ samattho nāma ekasākiyo'pi n'āhosi, sabbe vandiṃsu'y'eva.
samānabhāgaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.
raññā pana vandite bhagavantaṃ avanditvā ṭhātuṃ samattho nāma ekasākiyo'pi n'āhosi, sabbe vandiṃsu'y'eva.

66260.meaning1: should be respected; should be honoured
66260.meaning2: should be saluted, should be paid homage

examples.text: kathaṃ carahi sabbaññū, vanditabbā tathāgatā, kathaṃ avandiyā buddhā, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.

66261.meaning2: to pay respect; to honour; to worship

66262.meaning1: having bowed; having paid respect; having honoured
66262.meaning2: having saluted, paid homage, having honoured, having adored

examples.text: tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā kuṭivatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo

so satthārā dinnanaye ṭhatvā satthāraṃ vanditvā, ajja ādiṃ katvā mama santakaṃ dasikasuttamattam'pi maṃ abhibhavitvā anekasatā'pi rājāno vā corā vā gaṇhituṃ samatthā nāma mā hontu, agginā'pi mama santakaṃ mā ḍayhatu, udakenapi mā vuyhatū'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.

66264.grammar: aor 1st sg of vandi, irreg form of vandiṃ, trans (+acc)

examples.text: disvā pāsādachāyāyaṃ, caṅkamantaṃ nar'uttamaṃ, tattha naṃ upasaṅkamma, vandissaṃ puris'uttamaṃ.

66265.grammar: pr, pass of vi apa √kas, intrans (+abl)

examples.text: gilāno satisūpaṭṭhi, dve upaṭṭhākā duvāyusā, vapakāsa-samaṇasukhā, parikuppaṃ byasanena cā'ti.

66268.grammar: inf of caus of vi apa √kas, trans (+acc)
66268.meaning1: to live apart; to be separated; to be isolated (from)
66268.commentary: (ANa) alaṃ saṅghamhā vapakāsitun'ti cātuddisattā saṅghamhā nikkhamma ekako vasituṃ yutto, saṅghasobhanatāya pana saṅghe'pi vasituṃ yutto'y'eva.

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu n'ālaṃ saṅghamhā vapakāsituṃ. katamehi pañcahi?
ahaṃ kho, samaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmi. tvam'pi, samaṇa, kasassu ca vapassu ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjassū'ti.
punappunañ'c'eva vapanti bījaṃ, punappunaṃ vassati devarājā, punappunaṃ khettaṃ kasanti kassakā, punappunaṃ dhaññam'upeti raṭṭhaṃ.

66274.grammar: abs of caus of √vap, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: ahaṃ kho, samaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmi. tvam'pi, samaṇa, kasassu ca vapassu ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjassū'ti.
tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa pañcamattāni naṅgalasatāni payuttāni honti vappakāle.
rañño kira vappamaṅgaladivaso nāma hoti, tadā anekappakāraṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādenti.

ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodh'ārāme. atha kho vappo sakko nigaṇṭhasāvako yen'āyasmā mahāmoggallāno ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

66285.meaning1: time for sowing; planting season; October-November
66285.commentary: (SNa) vappakāle'ti vappanakāle bījanikkhepasamaye. tattha dve vappāni kalalavappañ'ca paṃsuvappañ'ca. paṃsuvappaṃ idha adhippetaṃ, tañ'ca kho paṭhamadivase maṅgalavappaṃ. (SNPa) vappakāle'ti vapanakāle, bījanikkhipakāle'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa pañcamattāni naṅgalasatāni payuttāni honti vappakāle.

66286.commentary: (ANa) uppalaṃ vappatī'ti uppalaṃ ropeti. sā nīl'uppalavanasañchannā hoti.

examples.text: mama sudaṃ, bhikkhave, pitu nivesane pokkharaṇiyo kāritā honti. ekattha sudaṃ, bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vappati, ekattha padumaṃ, ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ, yāva'd'eva mam'atthāya.
balavā puriso jivh'agge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saṃyūhitvā appakasirena vameyya

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ vamanaṃ

66296.meaning2: having vomited, having ejected, having discharged

examples.text: att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā nigaṇṭhā'ti.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā att'ukkaṃsakā paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
